pick.headline: Bush and Gorbachev meet in Helsinki on the Gulf crisis
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of September 10, 1990, carried a TASS report from PRAVDA on Gorbachev's arrival in Helsinki and Bush's arrival statement, hoping to strengthen a common approach to Iraq's "unjustifiable aggression" and speaking of a new world order.

alternates.headline: Tajikistan declares independence
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of September 10, 1991, carried Radio Dushanbe congratulating listeners on Tajikistan's state independence, adopted by the Supreme Soviet's extraordinary session, and Moscow INTERFAX in English on the declaration.
